title: Reports audit launch with concurrent pipeline support
summary: Add a Reports > Audit start control that submits the existing backend audit launch route, and make active-work launch guards job-kind aware so audit and pipeline jobs can coexist while duplicate audit/pipeline/rerun blockers remain enforced.
reason: Operators need to launch audit work from the Reports audit sub-tab and let that read-only audit run at the same time as the pipeline.
behavior_before: Reports could review/export/ignore audit rows but could not launch an audit. The audit launch facade reused the same bundle-wide active-work guard as pipeline start, so an active pipeline process blocked audit start.
behavior_after: Reports > Audit can stage and submit /api/audit/start. Audit launch/preflight ignore active pipeline-only blockers, still block active audit or CSV rerun work, and close-readiness continues to block on any active pipeline, audit, rerun, or other active work.
manual_validation: RED: PYTHONPATH=src apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe -m unittest tests.python.desktop.test_application_facade_process_launch.ApplicationFacadeProcessLaunchTests.test_audit_start_can_run_while_pipeline_is_active_but_rejects_duplicate_audit tests.python.desktop.test_service_process_kill.ProcessKillHelperTests.test_find_related_pipeline_processes_can_filter_by_job_kind tests.python.desktop.test_reports_view_static.ReportsViewStaticTests.test_reports_audit_controls_are_backend_owned failed on missing concurrent-audit behavior and Reports launch controls.
rollback_plan: Revert the Reports audit start panel/handler, remove reportsView.js from the /api/audit/start route ownership baseline, and restore bundle-wide active-work filtering in the process guard/related-process helpers.
notes: The smoke wrapper fails without PYTHONPATH=src in this local workspace because the bundled interpreter cannot import the src-layout mediapipeline package; the same wrapper passes when invoked with PYTHONPATH=src. The wrapper itself was not changed.
